title: Config-aware sentinel for vector ranking: automated evals and drift probes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight, config-aware sentinel that automatically runs targeted offline evals and statistical drift probes whenever embedding or reranker config/model changes are proposed. The sentinel should: 1) compute a compact eval delta report (precision/recall@k, MRR, NDCG, cosine-distribution KS, embedding-length histogram) for the changed config/model vs. the pinned baseline; 2) surface a pass/fail decision using configurable thresholds and hysteresis; 3) attach the report to the PR/rollout and optionally block merges or trigger additional shadow runs; 4) integrate with existing shadow-eval infra and alerting (Slack + PagerDuty) with actionable diagnostics. This ticket scopes the core engine, gating rules, and CI/webhook integration (no UX work).
acceptance_criteria: When a model or config PR touches embedding/re-ranking code or config, the CI invokes the sentinel and produces an eval report artifact attached to the PR
Report includes: precision@1/5/10, recall@k, MRR, NDCG, embedding cosine distribution KS statistic, mean embedding norm, sample of failed queries with nearest neighbors and ground truth

If any metric crosses the configured regression thresholds (per-label thresholds + composite score), the sentinel marks the PR with a red status and posts a diagnostic message to #quality-alerts and the PR thread
Config-driven thresholds are stored in a YAML config checked into infra repo and support per-workload overrides
Shadow re-runs are automatically scheduled for high-risk changes (models, quantization, new tokenizers) and results are viewable in the runtime-evals dashboard
Signal quality: false positive rate < 3% against historical tuning set after one week of calibration
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable sentinel for internal infra-only repos and model-team PRs for 2 weeks; collect calibration data and tune thresholds. Phase 2: widen to all embedding/reranker changes and wire status checks to protected branches. Phase 3: integrate optional auto-block plus automatic rollback policy for Dedicated customers with high SLAs.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy metrics produce false positives and slow down developer velocity. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds + 24h calibration window + opt-out label for experimental branches. Risk: compute cost of re-running shadow evals. Mitigation: sample-based shadowing and budgeted nightly batches for expensive comparisons.
implementation_notes: Design a modular sentinel: (1) change-detector (diffs file paths + config keys); (2) lightweight eval runner that replays a fixed probe set and synthetic probes; (3) statistical test library (KS, Welch t-test, bootstrap CIs); (4) PR status reporter and artifact uploader to S3; (5) alerting hook to Slack/PagerDuty and runtime-evals dashboard. Reuse existing harness from ENG-22011 for probes and ENG-41102 gating infra where possible.
